[{"sha":"d13027b8e53f868f09b3555e8722b21d655b607b","node_id":"C_kwDONGKYgdoAKGQxMzAyN2I4ZTUzZjg2OGYwOWIzNTU1ZTg3MjJiMjFkNjU1YjYwN2I","commit":{"author":{"name":"Faraz Kayani","email":"faraz.kayani2322@gmail.com","date":"2026-05-18T12:34:42Z"},"committer":{"name":"Faraz Kayani","email":"faraz.kayani2322@gmail.com","date":"2026-05-18T12:34:42Z"},"message":"Add MAI 2026 image denoising models with knowledge distillation

Adds two image denoising models from the Mobile AI 2026 Image
Denoising Challenge (CVPRW 2026):

- LiteDenoiseNet: 1.96M-parameter NPU-friendly student model built
  entirely from hardware-friendly primitives (3x3 convs, ReLU,
  strided downsampling, nearest-neighbor upsampling). Designed for
  fallback-free execution on mobile NPUs.

- HeavyDenoiseNet: 41.6M-parameter U-Net-style teacher model with
  dense denoising blocks and PReLU activations. Used as the
  supervisor for knowledge distillation of the lightweight student.

Supporting files:
- ab/nn/loader/denoise.py: augmented data loader with 2-pixel buffer
  crops, geometric augmentations (horizontal/vertical flips and
  90/180/270 degree rotations), and separate deterministic
  validation cropping.
- ab/nn/transform/denoise.py: tensor conversion transform.

Includes training statistics (300 epochs each) for both models.

Reference: 'Real Image Denoising with Knowledge Distillation for
High-Performance Mobile NPUs', CVPRW
